# CertifyMe

> CertifyMe is a verifiable digital credential software platform for institutions that need to issue, manage, and verify digital certificates, open badges, and learner portfolios at scale.

## What is CertifyMe?

CertifyMe (by Tech99 Innovations Pvt Ltd) is an enterprise-grade digital credentialing platform that enables educational institutions, corporations, associations, and e-learning providers to issue tamper-proof, verifiable digital credentials compliant with Open Badges 3.0 standards.

## Core Product

- **Digital Certificates** — branded, verifiable, shareable certificate webpages with QR codes
- **Open Badges** — Open Badges 3.0 compliant digital badges for skills and achievements
- **Learner Portfolios** — portable, verified skill records for learners
- **Credential Verification** — QR-code and URL-based independent verification
- **White-Label Credentialing** — fully branded credential experience
- **Bulk Issuance** — issue thousands of credentials with minimal manual effort
- **Analytics** — credential engagement and sharing analytics
- **API & Integrations** — REST API, Zapier, LMS integrations, HR system integrations

## Industries Served

- Higher Education (universities, colleges — transcripts, degree certificates, report cards)
- E-Learning Platforms (course completion badges, micro-credentials)
- Corporate Learning & Development (skill badges, training certifications)
- Professional Associations (membership badges, certification management)
- Schools (K-12 certificates)

## Key Features

- Open Badges 3.0 compliant credentials
- QR code verification on every credential
- Social sharing (LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook)
- LMS integrations (Academy Ocean, Airteach, AxisLMS, BambooHR, and more)
- Custom branding and white-label options
- Bulk CSV upload for credential issuance
- API access for programmatic credential management — see https://www.certifyme.online/api/
- Multi-language credential support
- GDPR, FERPA, COPPA, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 9001 compliant
- No sensitive data upload required (no learner email needed for issuance)

## Standards & Compliance

- Open Badges 3.0 (IMS Global)
- ISO 9001 certified
- ISO 27001 certified
- ISO 27701 certified
- GDPR compliant
- FERPA compliant
- COPPA compliant

## Differentiators

- Ranked #1 Leader in Digital Credential Management Software (G2, TrustRadius, Capterra)
- Credentials issue to 144+ countries
- 500+ institutions trust CertifyMe
- 4.8/5 average rating from 563+ verified reviews
- Advertising banner space built into credential pages (monetization opportunity)
- No technical knowledge required — single-click awarding
- Independent verification (not reliant on CertifyMe servers)

## Pricing

- Free plan available (5 credentials)
- Paid plans for startups to enterprise
- See full pricing: https://www.certifyme.online/pricing

## API & Developer Access

CertifyMe provides a REST API for programmatic credential issuance and management.

- **API Base URL:** https://my.certifyme.online/api/v2/
- **API Reference Docs:** https://cme-api-v2.readme.io
- **API Page (website):** https://www.certifyme.online/api/
- **Credential API (Basic):** Award, retrieve, edit, delete credentials via POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /v2/credential
- **Template API (Advanced):** Create, copy, edit, delete credential templates
- **Project Manager API (Advanced):** Create and retrieve credential folders by institution
- **Analytics API (Advanced):** Retrieve credential engagement metrics by template ID
- **AI Agent Index:** https://cme-api-v2.readme.io/llms.txt
